block_id_patch: 1J5_patch — added Route F (blurred peripheral observation) and search-tree/MCTS framing

accepted_findings.visit_breadth: 22/60 objects visited, 82.5% of FN from unvisited positives

route_a_breadth_preserving.justification: C13 achieves 0.7163 on visited vs C0b 0.5570. 82.5% FN from unvisited. Two-pass separates observation from probing.
route_a_breadth_preserving.success_criterion: C15 macro_bal > C0b (0.5871), positive recall > C0b (0.31), selective probing
route_a_breadth_preserving.invalid_if: probes nearly all objects, requires hidden info, exploits negative-only tradeoff

route_b_differentiating_action.justification: 59.1% probes on non-differentiating actions, 61.5% of those zero-gain. Diff-action probes 66.7% effective.
route_b_differentiating_action.success_criterion: differentiating action probe rate > 60%, effective probe rate improves, macro_bal improves
route_b_differentiating_action.invalid_if: hard-codes differentiating action from ground truth, uses hidden_category

route_c_minority_targeting.justification: 2/12 minority visited, enrichment 1.0. Minority probes 0% effective (sample too small).
route_c_minority_targeting.success_criterion: minority enrichment > 1.5, more minority objects probed, effective minority probe rate improves
route_c_minority_targeting.invalid_if: uses hidden_subtype directly, achieves enrichment by chance
route_c_minority_targeting.reason: Likely addressed as side effect of Route A. Re-evaluate after A+B.

route_d_environment_redesign.justification: category_majority = 0.975. Only 0.025 gap to oracle. 80/20 ratios create strong category shortcut.
route_d_environment_redesign.invalid_if: designed to make C13 win, iterated until C13 looks good, not pre-registered
route_d_environment_redesign.reason: Fix policy design first. Pre-register environment before any runs. Only pursue if A+B cannot beat C0b.

route_e_cost_redesign.candidate: separate budgets / lower probe cost / larger total budget
route_e_cost_redesign.justification: Budget 1.5 forces 22/60 visits. C0b visits 60 at cost 1.13 leaving 0.37 unused.
route_e_cost_redesign.success_criterion: C13 visits more objects, macro_bal improves, tradeoff less extreme
route_e_cost_redesign.invalid_if: tuned until C13 wins, probe_cost so low probing is free, post-hoc changes
route_e_cost_redesign.reason: Premature. Current costs validated by 1J2. Revisit if A+B show promise but are budget-constrained.

route_f_blurred_peripheral_observation.addresses: visit_breadth_loss (indirectly) + poor_minority_subtype_targeting + lack of local scene/context distribution
route_f_blurred_peripheral_observation.justification: Current observation is point-like. C13 fails partly because narrow focal probing loses scene coverage. Multi-layer observation may help the agent estimate local positive/negative sample balance and identify better objects for focused probing.
route_f_blurred_peripheral_observation.success_criterion: C0b improves moderately but does not saturate, C_oracle - C0b >= 0.10, no true label or hidden subtype leakage, policy can use local context to improve object selection
route_f_blurred_peripheral_observation.invalid_if: blurred observation reveals hidden subtype directly, local context makes category_majority shortcut even stronger, observation alone reaches near-oracle and removes probe value
route_f_blurred_peripheral_observation.reason: Keep as interface-level Route F after C15/C15+B, or if 1J6/1J7 show point-like observation remains the bottleneck.

search_tree_mcts_framing.description: Mini-MC framed as cost-constrained search over object-action decision tree. Design analogy only, not a claim of MCTS implementation.

mapping.breadth_expansion: observe more objects / expand local scene coverage
mapping.depth_expansion: probe selected object-action branches to reduce subtype uncertainty
mapping.value_estimate: expected query-level gain / macro_bal improvement from visiting+probing
mapping.rollout_leaf_evaluation: IOM posterior prediction given current observations and probe outcomes
mapping.stopping_criterion: budget-aware termination — stop when no remaining object has positive expected net VOI
mapping.exploration_exploitation: visit new objects (explore) vs probe already-visited objects deeper (exploit)

search_tree_mcts_framing.two_pass_mapping: Pass 1 (breadth-first): observe many objects cheaply to build a wide search frontier. Pass 2 (depth-selective): probe high-value frontier nodes. C13 is depth-biased; C0b is breadth-only; C15 aims for breadth-then-depth balance.
search_tree_mcts_framing.c13_diagnosis_in_search_terms: C13 is depth-biased: spends budget on probe depth for a small set of objects, leaving most of the search space unexplored.
search_tree_mcts_framing.c0b_diagnosis_in_search_terms: C0b is breadth-only: sees all objects but never probes depth.
search_tree_mcts_framing.future_directions: May inform interleaved breadth-depth, UCB-style object selection, explicit VOI bandits. No MCTS implementation planned for immediate next blocks.

final_recommendation.next_block_description: Implement and evaluate C15_two_pass_observe_then_probe on seed=101
